editorial_thesis: The freshest practical signal is a shift from agent capability to agent operating discipline: memory must be editable, evidence must survive missing context, and tool access must be measurable and bounded.

topic_groups.title: Agent Memory: Forgetting, Drift, and Worth
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Memory has been covered recently, but today’s papers are a material update: they test forgetting, evolving facts, resource cost, and experience-memory usefulness rather than recall alone.

sources.title: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data
sources.why_selected: Tests answer reliability and diagnoses which memory nodes fail as data changes.
sources.usefulness: Add evolving-record tests to Buildn memory and client knowledge workflows.

sources.title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
sources.why_selected: Treats memory selection as a resource-allocation problem instead of a free quality boost.
sources.usefulness: Use value-per-token and value-per-latency gates for persistent agent state.

sources.title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents?
sources.why_selected: Shows experience memory benefits depend on the warmup pool and task distribution.
sources.usefulness: Require matched baselines before claiming that memory improves outcomes.

sources.title: Can Agents Forget When Asked? Bemula benchmark
sources.why_selected: Evaluates retention, efficacy, relearning, attacks, and over-deletion after a forget request.
sources.usefulness: Turn deletion into a tested product promise, not a UI affordance.

sources.title: MemForm: Benchmarking Memory Formation Poisoning
sources.why_selected: Measures adversarial manipulation at the point where persistent memory is formed.
sources.usefulness: Threat-model memory writes before optimizing retrieval.

topic_groups.title: Evidence + Agent Assurance
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A neglected lane with direct delivery value: current research is making missing evidence, human stewardship, and maturity claims testable instead of leaving assurance as prose.

sources.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Safety and Evidence Recovery under Missing Evidence
sources.why_selected: Benchmarks whether agents recover safely when required evidence is unavailable.
sources.usefulness: Add an explicit abstain-and-escalate path to research and ops agents.

sources.title: Contestable Agents for Data Governance
sources.why_selected: Records human stewardship of AI-generated metadata across structured and unstructured systems.
sources.usefulness: Prototype contestable artifact histories for client-facing automation.

sources.title: AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model
sources.why_selected: Connects agent maturity claims to evidence, adversarial tasks, and bounded execution.
sources.usefulness: Use evidence grades to keep Buildn specs honest about readiness.

sources.title: Holding Agents Accountable with Verifiable Agent Insurance
sources.why_selected: Explores machine-checkable violation reporting and accountability signals.
sources.usefulness: Borrow explicit violation events for review packets and incident trails.

sources.title: AI Security Incident Reporting for Compromised Agents
sources.why_selected: Provides a framing for reporting incidents specific to compromised agent behavior.
sources.usefulness: Create a lightweight incident schema before deploying higher-authority agents.

topic_groups.title: Agent-Ready Data Infrastructure
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh cloud signal widens the practical stack beyond models: context catalogs, managed-agent deployment choice, and agentic data access are becoming product surfaces.

sources.title: Knowledge Catalog: self-learning context enrichment for AI agents
sources.why_selected: Google claims nearly 4× accuracy, lower latency, and fewer tokens through context enrichment.
sources.usefulness: Compare curated context with raw retrieval on a real Buildn corpus.

sources.title: Expanding Claude availability and deployment choice on Google Cloud
sources.why_selected: Adds deployment choice around Claude Platform features and managed agents.
sources.usefulness: Map provider, residency, and execution choices before client pilots.

sources.title: MCP Toolbox Java SDK v1.0
sources.why_selected: Makes governed enterprise data access a typed SDK integration point.
sources.usefulness: Evaluate whether tool contracts can replace bespoke connector glue.

sources.title: PostgreSQL for agents in AlloyDB
sources.why_selected: Moves agent-facing database operations closer to the data layer.
sources.usefulness: Keep retrieval, permissions, and audit near transactional data.

sources.title: Temporal serverless workers on Cloud Run
sources.why_selected: Targets multi-step agent workloads with elastic workers and durable orchestration.
sources.usefulness: Use durable workflows for resumable research and client automations.

topic_groups.title: Governed Developer Surfaces
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh operational lane: GitHub’s October 23 changes connect agent usage measurement, chat-to-code intake, and enterprise app installation into a more governable delivery surface.

sources.title: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
sources.why_selected: Usage reporting now covers more developer tools instead of only first-party surfaces.
sources.usefulness: Measure accepted work and model usage across the actual toolchain.

sources.title: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
sources.why_selected: Connects team notifications to Copilot actions in a collaboration surface.
sources.usefulness: Prototype issue-to-review workflows with explicit approval checkpoints.

sources.title: Enterprise installations for GitHub Apps generally available
sources.why_selected: Makes app installation and ownership more manageable across enterprises.
sources.usefulness: Use enterprise-owned integrations instead of personal tokens for client work.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics
sources.why_selected: Provides the surrounding usage vocabulary needed to interpret new API coverage.
sources.usefulness: Define outcome metrics before turning on more agent capacity.

sources.title: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
sources.why_selected: Reinforces the direction toward narrower, administrable integration authority.
sources.usefulness: Audit every client integration for owner, scopes, expiry, and revocation.
